review: Strictly speaking my question is not whether I like this — it is whether three hundred children can sing it in a room with bad acoustics and a piano cart. They can. "Gracias, God!" put a Spanish word in the mouths of second-graders in Kansas without making a lesson of it, which is a better argument for the doctrine of the nations than the unit I teach on it. I am going to apologise for the length of this and then not shorten it: I have emailed twice to ask what I am licensed to do with this in a tuition-charging school, and I have had no reply, and I am currently doing it anyway on the assumption that nobody minds. That is not a comfortable place for a teacher to be.
